correctness.rationale: PASS: The standard 24-permutation adjacent-swap graph has 36 edges. All 7-vertex dominating sets are absent and exactly 1767 eight-vertex dominating sets exist. For each such D and v outside D, define Q(D,v) as selected incident edges; D ceases dominating after edge deletion F iff at least one Q(D,v)⊆F. Therefore gamma(T−F)>8 iff every D is destroyed, a finite exact criterion. An independently written C++ exhaustive enumeration over all 0..5-edge F gave bondage counts 0,0,0,0,0,276, with examined k5 count C(36,5)=376992; under 48 value-permutation/position-reversal actions it gave eight orbits of sizes 12,24,24,24,48,48,48,48. Source independent Python alternative inspected. This is a complete finite proof rather than extrapolation.
